name: Fourier Epicycles
desc: A luminous chain of nested rotating epicycle circles whose tip traces a glowing gold spirograph curve into a bright decay-trail, the harmonic coefficients drifting so the figure endlessly reinvents itself; renders as a spectral phosphor glow, hue-cycled neon, warm gold, a cyan construction blueprint, or sepia ink-plot.

scale.doc: curve radius (fills more of the frame)

density.doc: number of epicycle arms / curve intricacy

arms.doc: visibility of the rotating construction circles
